scope: nonzero prescribed internal-phase contract through the existing fixed-geometry pipeline, SHADOW writer, and independent contract reader

source_identity.qualification: The tests compiled the working-tree sources listed below; HEAD identifies the base revision, not the tested source tree.

assertions: The actual run_cloud_bal_pipeline output contains a nonzero liquid-condensation candidate whose phase extent was independently fixed before invocation.
External source and boundary increments are zero and remain distinct from the prescribed phase ledger.
The actual SHADOW writer publishes the nonzero candidate after replaying the same physical contract.
The independent physical-contract reader replays the nonzero artifact and corruption mutations under both writer profiles.
Legacy no-phase writer/readback and pressure-transition full-file replay pass under both profiles.

focused_tests.command_recipe: source tests/intel_toolchain.sh; create a fresh /var/tmp build directory per O0/O2 profile; compile and run test_pipeline from cloud_bal_state, cloud_bal_column_physics, cloud_bal_grid_geometry, cloud_bal_balance_operator, cloud_bal_pipeline; compile and run test_pressure_thermo_state, test_water_phase_transfer, and test_pressure_phase_transfer from cloud_bal_state and cloud_bal_column_physics. Use CLOUD_BAL_FREE_FLAGS for O0 and CLOUD_BAL_REPRO_FLAGS for O2.
regressions: Invalid NaN water placeholders fail the pipeline with REASON_METADATA, full output rollback, and empty accepted budget; invalid payload equality is tested without ordered NaN comparisons.
Contract storage closure canonicalizes changed cells and preserves a valid inactive dry-mass value bitwise.
focused_tests.command_log_note: No complete focused compile/run stdout-stderr log was retained. log_receipt.path is only the concise PASS marker; command_recipe plus per-executable hashes are the available evidence.

scope_and_limits.supports: A synthetic 4x4x3, fixed-pressure, independently predeclared nonzero internal-phase candidate can pass the existing pipeline contract, SHADOW writer replay, and independent physical-contract readback at pinned Intel O0/O2.
does_not_support: Production schema-7 admission of the 4x4x3 artifact.
Source/boundary authority authentication, global optimizer or joint physical optimality.
Native KDM6 acceptance, full NE57 coupled balance, initial-shock reduction or forecast benefit.
scope_and_limits.schema7_gate: The top-level production validator retains its 235x283x22 domain gate. It was intentionally not invoked to admit the 4x4x3 synthetic artifact; the dedicated physical-contract reader checks only the scoped optional contract and endpoint semantics.
scope_and_limits.canonicalization: Only explicit fixed-pressure contracts use changed-cell stored dry-mass reconstruction; the physical phase extent remains based on the pre-transfer dry carrier. The caller's predeclared tolerance bounds the representation residual and does not declare it a physical source or phase term.

excluded_attempts.reason: Wrong default workspace root made the pinned nf-config dependency unavailable.
The O0 writer and physical readers passed, but an interim modified pressure-transition assertion failed; the assertion was restored to the HEAD legacy replay contract before run9.
An interim rollback test used ordinary equality on invalid NaN payloads and included a mistaken standalone-kernel dry-mass assertion. Both test expectations were corrected; focused3 passed.
